The potential impact of this documentary is likely to be significant within the fields of environmental science, animal ethics, and consumer behavior. By exposing the harsh realities of factory farming, the film serves as a powerful catalyst for shifting public opinion. It may lead to a measurable decrease in demand for conventional meat and dairy products, thereby pressuring the agricultural industry to adopt more humane and sustainable practices. Simultaneously, it is expected to boost the market for vegan and cruelty-free alternatives, accelerating the growth of the plant-based food sector. This shift could also influence policy debates regarding environmental regulations and animal welfare standards.
